_notes: 492 of 1002 console keys had no Japanese at all (cur = null); all are translated here. Agency copy is imperative and dense; University copy is formal (貴学, 志願者, 判定).

Document review in the agency console keeps the existing vocabulary 書類審査 / 審査キュー / 承認 (Verify); the university's own review of an application is 大学審査 (unified: v27.stage.REVIEW said 大学の審査, v22.stage.review said 大学審査).
'Waiting on' was 待機対象 (a thing being held); re-rendered as 対応待ち, matching the existing values 学生の対応待ち / 大学の対応待ち. 'Waiting on us' = こちらの対応待ち.
'Reply owed' chips were 返信待ち, which reads as 'waiting for THEIR reply'; re-rendered as 要返信 (we owe the reply) and the sub-lines as 返信が必要な会話.
Agency = エージェント everywhere (提携エージェント, 担当エージェント); the two エージェンシー strings in this job were aligned. Other エージェンシー strings exist in marketing.json outside this job.
Notarization & legalization = 公証・認証 (the university documents label had dropped notarization). Apostille/consular legalization stay アポスティーユ / 領事認証.
Withdrawn: the university console says 辞退 (declined after offer) where common says 取り下げ; left as the admissions officers' vocabulary — owner's call whether to unify.
Arrival: console stage chips say 入国済み; common pipeline chips were aligned in the marketing-common patch.
Half-width ': ' in three agency strings was changed to full-width '：' for consistency.
Hangyul HQ = Hangyul 本部; Hangyul operations = Hangyul 運営; D-30/D+30 is written as 入国30日前〜30日後 as the pricing page does.
